exceptions.reason: dScStarSel_c_classInit is the profile factory, moved verbatim from the retired src/game/stages/d_s_star_sel.cpp, which spells these names on main. Model's C1/D1 are passed by address to __cxa_vec_ctor, and C++ cannot take a constructor's or destructor's address. fBase_c's operator new and C2 are the inlined steps of a `new dScStarSel_c` expression. Follow-up: rewrite the factory as `new dScStarSel_c` once dScStarSel_c's constructor is reconstructed, which retires all four.

exceptions.reason: OAM::Render's scaled overload takes two Fix12<int> by value, and include/OAM.h deliberately leaves the by-value Fix12 overloads out: a method with that parameter homes r0-r3 to the stack, which the ROM callers do not. Message::Update calls it eight times to draw the choice cursor and the next-page arrow; the ninth occurrence is the extern "C" declaration. Follow-up: retire it together with the other Fix12-by-value walls once a Fix12 spelling that passes in registers exists.
